_comment: Fixture standing in for the pm_signal_adjudication_v0 workflow's output.
signal_id is a placeholder because a real signal_id is derived from the
content hash of the evidence that produced it — the E2E test substitutes
the id of the signal it actually emitted, exactly as the workflow would.
rationale: The release revises the Q1 GDP figure from 3.1% to 2.4%, which is the exact statistic and vintage this market resolves on. The market observation predates the release and the midpoint has not moved, so the revision does not appear to be priced in.

alignment.notes: The market's resolution source is the official release page this SourceSpec collects; the changed figure is the deciding value.
alignment.resolution_mapping: Resolves YES if the published Q1 real GDP annual rate is below 3.0 percent.

invalidation: A subsequent estimate revising the Q1 figure back to 3.0 percent or above before the market resolves.
telegram_message: PAPER ONLY — Q1 GDP revised 3.1% -> 2.4% on the designated resolution source; market has not repriced.

ledger_proposal.thesis: The second-estimate revision to 2.4% satisfies the sub-3.0% resolution criterion and the market midpoint has not yet moved.
invalidations: A later estimate revises the Q1 figure back to 3.0 percent or above
The market resolves before the first markout horizon
